title: Theodore's Booze Blues & BBQ
venue_description:
Theodore's Booze Blues & BBQ - Best Blues Club in the Country

Theodore's Booze Blues & BBQ is a legendary blues club and barbecue restaurant located at 201 Worthington Street in Springfield's Entertainment District. Since 1979 Theodore's has been a mainstay for blues music and hickory-smoked barbecue in Springfield. In 2004 The Blues Foundation recognized the venue with a prestigious Keeping the Blues Alive (KBA) Award and named it Best Blues Club in the Country.

Barbecue Excellence

Theodore's specializes in slow-smoked barbecue prepared fresh daily. All meats are hand-rubbed then smoked with local maple oak or hickory wood. The smokers are loaded the night before and every morning to ensure fresh product. Daily specials often sell out due to limited quantities of fresh-smoked meats. The menu includes ribs pulled pork brisket chicken and sausage with traditional Southern sides.

Blues Foundation Recognition

The Blues Foundation is the official nonprofit organization dedicated to preserving blues music and inducting musicians into the Blues Hall of Fame. The KBA Awards recognize venues individuals and organizations that actively work to preserve blues music and support the blues community. Theodore's 2004 recognition as Best Blues Club in the Country represents an extraordinary honor and validation of the venue's contribution to blues culture.

Live Music Programming

Theodore's features live music seven nights a week showcasing the best in national regional and local blues acts. The stage provides an intimate setting for performances. Wednesday open mic nights feature a professional house band providing customizable backup for performers of all skill levels. Weekend performances attract larger crowds.

Entertainment District Location

Located in Springfield's Entertainment District on Worthington Street the venue is part of a growing arts and music community. The district has been undergoing revitalization with increased investment in entertainment venues and cultural programming.

Atmosphere & Community

Theodore's maintains a casual welcoming atmosphere that emphasizes community and good music. The combination of excellent barbecue craft beverages and world-class live blues creates a destination venue that attracts visitors from across New England. The venue functions as both a restaurant and music hall bringing together food and music culture.
